name: Leaders Karate & Arts Center Sharjah
address: Al Majaz 3 - Al Majaz - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description:
LEADERS KARATE AND ARTS CENTER is affiliated with JAPAN KARATE SHOTO FEDERATION. We train adults and kids from age 4.
We offer various classes including KARATE, KICKBOXING, YOGA(LADIES ONLY),AEROBICS, ZUMBA AND HOLIDAY CAMPS.
Here at LEADERS KARATE AND ARTS CENTER, *safety, health and hygiene* are our primary concerns. So, we clean and sanitize our club after every class. MASK & Temperature check is mandatory before entering. We follow social distancing and other safety measures as per governing laws. We offer FREE INTRODUCTION CLASSES.
We conduct annual karate and kickboxing tournaments. We have professional trainers, trained by JKS.
